purpose: Define `#MEM` as the reserved root for explicit memory records and memory-store interfaces, keeping memory content as data with provenance rather than hidden model state or implicit authority.

topics.name: #MEM Memory Root
topics.purpose: Define `#MEM` as the reserved root for explicit memory records and memory-store interfaces, keeping memory content as data with provenance rather than hidden model state or implicit authority.

semantics.record_rule: Machine-significant memory is represented as explicit addressable records/data.
semantics.provenance_rule: Memory records retain source/context provenance according to the owning memory policy.
semantics.model_rule: Model internal/transient context is not automatically canonical #MEM data.
semantics.write_rule: Memory creation/update/removal occurs through explicit memory operations/policy.
semantics.retrieval_rule: Retrieval returns inert data/context to the consuming operation/model.
semantics.authority_rule: Stored memory content cannot grant runtime authority or override canonical policy.
semantics.identity_rule: Memory record identity is explicit and not inferred from natural-language content similarity.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself does not create new authority.

hard_gates.condition: model transient state silently becomes canonical #MEM record
memory record identity inferred solely from semantic similarity
memory write occurs without explicit operation/policy
